data.title: Anthropic Could Be Worth More Than Bitcoin by Year-End, Polymarket Traders Say
data.description: Just five years after its founding, Anthropic could become more valuable than all Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) in circulation, with Polymarket traders giving the AI company a 77% chance of overtaking the cryptocurrency before year-end. Anthropic filed its IPO prospectus Monday,...
